description:
Hello here is my footage I took, during my exploration around about and inside, the old Prudential Insurance, derelict office blocks, near the Scottish City of Stirling. 
I hope you enjoy it and, thankyou for selecting it.

comments.text: Good video. Concrete structures of this type always strike me as being austere and soulless, more so when undergoing demolition. Please, as I'm sure you are, be aware of the risk of asbestos around old buildings.
